conviction_note: Both halves of the period's AuMA and flows were disclosed on 22 Jul and 21 Oct, and no guidance is given. What is new is H1 profit against a bar I could not source, the first interim dividend, which is mechanical under the minimum-50%-of-adjusted-EPS policy, and whether a buyback is renewed after the last one expired on 30 Jun. The only lean is a small positive: a renewal pattern at the last two interims, CFO buying, and a sympathy sell-off on Ninety One's print. Against it, the house broker flagged further revenue-margin compression. So p_up is 53 on an abs_move of 5.0 (thin turnover, a name that moved 12.6% and 18.2% on its last two non-update RNS days), giving +0.3. The findings sum to +0.8 and are not fitted to that number.

findings.finding: The £10m buyback announced with last year's interims ran only to 30 June 2026 and appears to have finished. Buybacks were launched at both of the last two interims (£5m in Nov 2024, £10m in Nov 2025), and surplus capital after foreseeable dividends was £29.0m at 31 Mar 2026, so a renewal is a live new item in this release. It is worth up to ~6% of a ~£165m market cap, less the £6m Hawksmoor cash outlay.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Nov 2024 interims with a new £5m buyback and the dividend held: +8.3%. Nov 2025 interims with a new £10m buyback and the first interim cut to 7p: +1.6%
findings.why_not_priced: Renewal is an inference from the pattern, not an announcement. The stock fell 8% in the five sessions into the print, which is not what the tape would show if a renewal were being bid up, and the 8 or so analysts can see the same pattern, so it is partly expected
